name: The Wilds
description: The darker region beyond the Realm of Eldraine, filled with fairy-tale wonder and danger.

description_citations.text: "Wilds of Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko abducts the High King and turns him into a stag, around 4561 AR.
timeline.quote: After the High King was abducted by Oko , the fey, around 4561 AR and turned into a stag

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The royal twins set out at eighteen to find their father.
timeline.quote: When the royal twins turned eighteen, they set out on a quest to find their father.

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Algenus is returned to life with his magical sword, and the twins' planeswalker spark ignites, sending them to a new plane.
timeline.quote: Learning the truth of their past, the Kenrith twins' shared Planeswalker's spark ignited, sending them across the Blind Eternities to a new plane.

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko and Garruk rescue the twins from redcaps in the Wilds.
timeline.quote: they are unexpectedly rescued by Oko and Garruk.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Harvest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Titus is killed by a lich-lord in the heartland of the Wilds.
timeline.quote: The rash Titus is first attacked by a drake and then killed by a lich-lord .

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko transforms Elowen into an eagle and traps the party in a thorn ring; Rowan realizes the stag is her father.
timeline.quote: So Oko changes Elowen into a crested eagle, which flies away, and traps the remaining company in a faerie ring of thorns and nettles.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cerise removes the hedron from Garruk, freeing his will but unleashing the Chain Veil's curse.
timeline.quote: While this has the desired effect of Garruk regaining his memories and his own will, it also returns the Chain Veil 's curse to its full force.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk corrupts and kills Cado's griffin Hale out of pity.
timeline.quote: Garruk corrupts Hale, Cado's griffin , and then kills it out of pity.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Will's persistence summons the Cauldron of Eternity, which lifts Garruk's curse.
timeline.quote: Will's act of persistence summons the Cauldron of Eternity .

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Wild Hunt a figure looking like Queen Ayara mortally wounds the stag with an arrow.
timeline.quote: A brawl ensues, which ends with a person looking like Queen Ayara shooting the stag with an arrow and mortally wounding it.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The murderer is revealed to be Oko in disguise, who planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: The murderer is revealed to be Oko in disguise.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The dying stag transforms back into Algenus Kenrith.
timeline.quote: As it dies, it transforms back into the form of Algenus Kenrith.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Linden reveals the witch fed Algenus a love potion, and Algenus killed her.
timeline.quote: The witch had fed Algenus a love potion that had stolen his memory and his heart.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Linden uses the sword's life to return Algenus to the living; Rowan's spark ignites and she and Will vanish.
timeline.quote: As there is still life in Algenus' sword from the well, Linden uses it to return him to the world of the living.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kellan, with Ruby, kills Agatha and defeats Hylda.
timeline.quote: Kellan, with the help of Ruby , succeeded in killing Agatha and defeating Hylda.

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Talion tasks a young human with fae blood with vanquishing the three witch sisters to end the Wicked Slumber.
timeline.quote: the Fae Lord Talion tasks him with vanquishing the three witch sisters to end the Wicked Slumber once and for all

citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A witch enthralls Kenrith and kills the twins; Linden's kiss breaks the spell and she restores the twins with her sword.
timeline.quote: A kiss from Linden broke the spell on Kenrith

citation.text: "Algenus Kenrith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko abducts Kenrith and turns him into a stag.
timeline.quote: Kenrith was abducted by the anarchist Planeswalker Oko and turned into a magnificent stag

citation.text: "Algenus Kenrith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko mortally wounds Kenrith during the Wild Hunt; Linden restores him with her sword.
timeline.quote: Linden used it for the Restoration of the High King

citation.text: "Algenus Kenrith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ellivere ventures into the Wilds seeking a cure for the Wicked Slumber and is greeted by peaceful critters.
timeline.quote: Venture into the Wilds in search of a cure for the Wicked Slumber that assails the Realm.

citation.text: "Ellivere", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: The key conflict of Eldraine is the courts versus the magical creatures of the Wilds.
relations.quote: The key conflict of Eldraine is the five knightly courts vs. the magical creatures of the Wilds.
